Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need before joining.

What is the ASEAN AI for Education Summit?

A two-day international conference and hands-on workshop focused on building AI solutions for education in Southeast Asia.

Who can attend?

Software developers, AI engineers, educators, students, researchers, founders, companies, governments, and education institutions.

Do I need advanced AI experience?

No. Beginner, intermediate, and advanced participants are welcome, although basic programming knowledge is recommended for technical workshops.

What language will be used?

The primary event language is English.

What should I bring?

Bring a laptop, charger, valid identity document, QR ticket, development tools, and a GitHub account.

Can I change my workshop track?

Track changes may be allowed while capacity remains available.

How will I receive my QR code?

It is generated after successful payment and becomes available in your participant dashboard.

Will participants receive certificates?

Eligible participants receive a digital certificate after completing attendance requirements.

Can international participants attend?

Yes. Participants from all ASEAN countries and other international locations are welcome.

Is my contact information visible?

Private email, phone, passwords, payment details, and sensitive information are never displayed in the participant directory.
